name: Cometrox!
storyline:
The things you love — rock music most of all —
seem to be exactly the things this world has no patience for.
Even the girl you have a crush on visibly recoils at the sight of a guitar.
And right as you're about to get rid of every record and every guitar you've ever collected —
a mysterious green-haired girl comes crashing down out of the sky.
"This universe needs you to play!"
KAIJU shaking the ground.
An ordinary life taking a very sharp turn.
Can you hold on to what you love and save the world at the same time?
summary:
Nobody told the keyboard it wasn't a guitar.
COMETROX! is a game about picking up a guitar, throwing down with KAIJU and saving the universe.

No instrument to buy. No special controller.

The keyboard you lift off your desk is a guitar.
